items.statement: Bounded inference about test whether M3 has comparable evidence for interaction with PM6 and BTP-eC9 fragments and whether apparent attraction arises from electrostatics, dispersion or distortion.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
